info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Utility Billing Reminders-v1-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Reminders Retrieval API enables users to access a list of reminders associated with utility billing. This API provides essential insights into upcoming billing alerts, helping consumers manage their payments effectively. Typical users include utility service providers and consumers seeking to stay informed about their billing schedules. By integrating this API, applications can enhance their user experience and ensure timely payment awareness.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current billing reminders for a user. It provides important notifications regarding upcoming payments, due dates, and any relevant updates necessary for managing billing effectively.
